_doc: Voice lines. key -> public/sfx/vo_<key>.mp3 (registered in public/sfx/index.json). ann = arena announcer, ctl = CONTROL on the radio (the game band-passes it).

lines.text: Double kill!
Triple kill!
Rampage!
Unstoppable!
Headshot.
Takedown.
Overdrive!
Wave cleared.
Colossus... down!
Boots on the ground. Storm front is three minutes out.
Valve A is across the yard. Open it — we need pressure on the flare line.
Hostiles on the valve. Clear them.
Line A is live. Pressure is building. Now hold that yard.
More of them coming over the wall. Hold.
Here it comes. You will not see them in that — use your scan.
Another group, inside the sand. Ping them before they ping you.
Storm is passing... wait. Something big on the west ridge.
That is not on any manifest. Its cores are armoured — take out a knee.
Leg is gone! The armour blew — the cores are open, hit them!
It is overloading — it is stuck on the flare line. Light it. Now!
Burn it down!
One core down! It is venting — hit the other one.
It's down. Dropship is on the way — get to the pad.
Got you. Bringing you home.
Forget the valve — the storm is on you.
Eyes west. Something is walking out there.
Dropship is on approach. Hold at the pad, it's coming in hot.
Ramp is down! Get aboard, now!
Sending you a lance. Drop pod on your position — grab it.
Shield unit! Get behind it, or put a lance through it.
Drones over the wall! Watch the sky — they dive.
